steps.label: open the Tiles tab with the site kit
steps.goal: the site kit is the architectural set, and it is where the solver's content has to come from
steps.recovery: if the palette shows fridges and beds you are on the furniture kit: restart with --kit site

steps.label: start the corner tile
steps.goal: a corner is where two solid sides meet -- without it the solver can only make corridors
do: press N for a new tile
steps.recovery: if nothing changes you are not on the Tiles tab: press 2 first

steps.label: build the corner tile
steps.goal: floor plus TWO walls at right angles. The second wall needs R to turn it a quarter before you flush it.
do: Escape, walk to site/wall, Enter, then shift-arrow it flush
Enter again for a second wall, press R to turn it, then shift-arrow it flush to an adjacent side
steps.recovery: if the size line grows past 1 x 1, the line under it names the piece that did it -- plain arrows bring it back toward the middle

steps.label: save the corner tile
steps.goal: so the kit gains it and the solver can place it
steps.recovery: an empty tile is refused by name, and so is an id the vocabulary rejects

steps.label: start the low wall tile
steps.goal: a knee-high divider separates space without blocking sight, which a solver cannot express any other way
do: press N for a new tile
steps.recovery: if nothing changes you are not on the Tiles tab: press 2 first

steps.label: build the low wall tile
steps.goal: floor plus site/wall_low, flushed to one side. Same shape as the wall tile, different piece.
do: shift-arrow it flush against a side
steps.recovery: site/wall_low is 0.20 x 1.00 and flushes exactly the way site/wall does

steps.label: save the low wall tile
steps.goal: so the kit gains it and the solver can place it
steps.recovery: an empty tile is refused by name, and so is an id the vocabulary rejects

steps.label: do these four make a room
steps.goal: the last question no checkpoint can answer, and the one that decides whether this kit is worth extending
do: fill a region from the composed tiles with Cmd+G
say whether what comes out looks like architecture
steps.recovery: there is nothing to recover here -- an answer of no is the finding, and names the tile that is missing
